shortDescription: TotalEnergies EURONEXT:TTE and its Nigerian partner AMNI have made the final investment decision to develop the offshore Ima gas field in Nigeria, aiming to supply a Nigeria LNG liquefaction plant, the French oil major said on Wednesday.
